def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

lib_code = '''from collections import Counter

def find_separators(grid, axis, bg=None):
    """Indices of full rows (axis=0) or columns (axis=1) of a single non-background color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if bg is None:
        bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    if axis == 0:
        return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    return [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]

def tile_unit(grid, unit, vertical):
    """Tile the grid with a unit (list of rows if vertical else list of columns), wrapping periodically."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    p = len(unit)
    if vertical:
        return [list(unit[i % p]) for i in range(h)]
    return [[unit[c % p][r] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

def complete_tiling(grid):
    """Complete a partially tiled grid: find separator lines (full one-color non-background rows/columns),
    take the period-length unit ending at a separator that holds the most colors, and tile the whole grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    srows = find_separators(grid, 0, bg)
    scols = find_separators(grid, 1, bg)
    if srows and (len(srows) >= len(scols) or not scols):
        if len(srows) >= 2:
            p = srows[1] - srows[0]
            cands = [grid[s-p+1:s+1] for s in srows if s-p+1 >= 0]
        else:
            cands = [grid[:srows[0]+1]]
        unit = max(cands, key=lambda u: len({v for row in u for v in row}))
        return tile_unit(grid, unit, True)
    if scols:
        cols = [[grid[i][j] for i in range(h)] for j in range(w)]
        if len(scols) >= 2:
            p = scols[1] - scols[0]
            cands = [cols[s-p+1:s+1] for s in scols if s-p+1 >= 0]
        else:
            cands = [cols[:scols[0]+1]]
        unit = max(cands, key=lambda u: len({v for col in u for v in col}))
        return tile_unit(grid, unit, False)
    return grid
'''
